notes: Each step names the app, the demo user, the engine action (WZ.<action>) or 'view' for a read-only check, the expected result and the data used.
Steps whose action is an engine action advance automatically when that user performs it; 'view' steps are marked done from the demo toolbar.
{year} stands for the current year in seeded identifiers (for example ENG-{year}-000104).
Every scenario starts from the seed; use Reset in the demo toolbar for the cleanest run. All people and data are synthetic.
